BiblicalUsage: A stronghold is the word for a fortress, and it appears once, in a promise to prisoners. In Zechariah 9:12 the Lord says, turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee. A fortress for people who have nothing left but hope.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prisoners of hope is one of the finest names in Scripture, and the stronghold is where they are told to run.
